own_solution.law: The upward magnetic force is ILB. Equilibrium requires ILB = mg, giving I = (0.025 × 9.8)/(0.50 × 0.350) = 1.4 A. An additional aligned field q at the rod gives I = mg/[L(B + q)], with q expressed in tesla.
assumptions: The whole rod experiences the stated uniform field perpendicular to its length.
The current-carrying leads exert no force on the rod.
An addition to the field means an increase in its stated perpendicular magnitude.
